content:
The Transition from Traditional Automation to the Era of Agent-Based AI

UiPath, which operates in more than 50 countries worldwide and serves approximately 11,000 enterprise customers, is making a significant shift in its automation strategy. The company is accelerating its transition to a new model called “Agentic Automation” by expanding its traditional task automation processes.

This new approach aims not only to have robots perform defined tasks but also to manage more complex processes through AI-powered orchestration. According to UiPath’s vision, the new enterprise AI model is based on the integration of the following components:

  • AI Agents: Autonomous digital assistants with decision-making capabilities.
  • Software Robots: Classic RPA bots that handle repetitive tasks.
  • Human Collaboration: The inclusion of the human factor in process oversight and complex decision-making mechanisms.
  • Single Orchestration Layer: Synchronized management of all these components from a single hub.

With this transformation, UiPath aims to help businesses integrate AI technologies more deeply into their operational processes and increase efficiency.
